kai: quick drop-in: spun up tungsten-30b (q3_0) with speculative decode enabled to test window/adaptive heuristics. odd tail behavior, logging notes here.
mya: quick numbers?
kai: single-token batch=1 steady: baseline p50=22ms p95=120ms p99=260ms. spec win=4 p50=18ms p95=130ms p99=520ms during 10s bursts. steady-state p99 improves ~-40ms but bursts double tail.
arjun: sounds similar to earlier kernels hitting memcpy fallback. can you paste the smallest trace?
kai: pasted: 
``` 
[TRACE] id=6199990000 start spec=win4
stage=kv_prefetch start_ms=0.9 end_ms=4.1 -> stall_ms=135
kernel_hint=quant_pack -> memcpy_slow_path
sched: cpu_steal=21% user=78% ctxsw_inc
```
sophie: did you try node-local affinity or --no-prefetch?
kai: yes. --no-prefetch reduces p99 by ~160ms on bursts but raises p50 by ~4ms. affinity=node-local cuts p99 by ~90ms. so prefetch good for avg but amplifies stall under contention.
mya: any proof that mis-speculation causes quality drift? short sanity check?
kai: ran 1k QA toy set: top1-match baseline 99.6% spec-win4 99.1%. notable failures are incomplete/paraphrase answers, not inventing facts. example: 
Prompt: "Who invented the transistor?"
baseline: "John Bardeen, Walter Brattain, and William Shockley."
spec: "I think it was Bardeen and co, not sure of all names."
arjun: small divergence — suggests token-level mispredictions early in sequence can cascade. tradeoff curve exists.
sophie: ops: propose runtime heuristic: if cpu_steal>10% then spec_window=1 and prefetch=off. cheap mitigation while we fix kernel. also run a controlled grid: win=[1,2,4,8], prefetch=[on,off], affinity=[local,any], quant=[q3_0,q4_0].
bench-bot: queued rb-6199990011..rb-6199990030 (20 jobs). will upload traces to s3://rnw-exp/tungsten30b/6199990000/ and post links. ETA ~90m.
mya: plan for quality eval: 2k tight-QA + 1k open-summary + token-agreement metric + 200 human review samples for borderline diffs. if EM drop <0.5 and p99 delta <+120ms prefer canary.
arjun: add kernel debug flag --dump-memalign and run one job with deterministic-kernel=true to measure variance.
kai: will kick off deterministic job next. posting run IDs when live.
sophie: thanks. I'll monitor tail alerts and set temporary circuit-breaker: if p99 > +200ms for 5 consecutive mins rollback spec.
kai: ok queued. will share s3 links + brief csv of metrics when runs complete.
